name: translate
title: Translate
description: Translate text or the current selection with Google's own endpoint.
author: black

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.description: Translate typed text, with the saved language sets.

commands.name: translate-form
commands.title: Translate Form
commands.description: Translate text in a form, with the output beside it.

commands.name: quick-translate
commands.title: Quick Translate
commands.description: Translate typed text into every target at once.

commands.name: instant-translate-copy
commands.title: Instant Translate Copy
commands.description: Translate the selection and copy it.

commands.name: instant-translate-paste
commands.title: Instant Translate Paste
commands.description: Translate the selection and paste it back.

commands.name: instant-translate-view
commands.title: Instant Translate View
commands.description: Translate the selection and show it on screen.

preferences.name: langFrom
preferences.title: Source Language
preferences.description: The language text is translated from. Auto-detect reads it per request.

preferences.name: lang1
preferences.title: Primary Target Language
preferences.description: The main language everything is translated into.

preferences.name: lang2
preferences.title: Secondary Target Language
preferences.description: The second language, used by Translate and Translate Form.

preferences.name: autoInput
preferences.title: Autofill Input
preferences.label: Automatically fill input with selected text
preferences.description: When enabled, selected text from the foremost app fills the input field.

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Default Action
preferences.description: What Return does to a translation.

preferences.name: prioritizeCrossLanguage
preferences.title: Result Ordering
preferences.label: Prioritize cross-language translations
preferences.description: When the text is already in one of your target languages, move that result to the bottom.
